correctness.rationale: Exact white-noise kernels give the posterior error; minimizing precision splits yields the weighted ℓ1 coefficient penalty. Coefficient-sign and activation proofs reduce candidates to the derivative-only optimum and a mixed endpoint; a symbolic-checked Descartes transform, activation sign count, double-root critical case and positive shifted polynomial rule out all mixed interior maxima. Envelope derivatives and endpoint bounds give one and only one crossover. Programmatic reproduction checked 21 covariance integrals, all central symbolic identities and 131599 supplemental direct Gaussian comparisons; numeric checks are not global proof.

value.rationale: The measurement model optimizes a natural finite resource: precision shared between level and derivative observations of a Brownian path integral. The complete global decision policy, uniqueness, exact risk and first-order discontinuous switch at a nontrivial finite budget are structural facts not evident from the standard Gaussian-conditioning formula. Precise scope excludes multiple sites and more general noise/covariance models; no unsupported broader theorem is asserted.
